notes.title: I Am Not Dead – First Update!
notes.content:
I Am Not Dead – And Neither Is the Game


Okay, technically, this is the first update on Steam... Which means I never told you we were alive in the first place. Let’s fix that.


[hr][/hr]

New Devlog
I just dropped a new devlog over on YouTube:

Why I disappeared for 5 months

What’s been brewing in development

What’s next.
[previewyoutube="IwSfvkRYSms;full"][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

Funding!
Among us gave me money!

As you might have seen on the store page, the game is now funded by Outersloth which was also one of the reasons I stopped posting for a bit - I finally felt like I can just focus on development so I did that for a while, but more on that in the devlog above!


[hr][/hr]

Playtest and Involvement
Do you want to:

Playtest the game?

Talk to me?

Ask questions?

Give suggestions?

Then you should join the Alchemy Sheep Discord server !


[hr][/hr]

Short-Form Videos – Development in Tiny Bites
I've started making short-form videos on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok:

Quick insights into development of the game

Showcasing more specific things

Occasional dev chaos in 60 seconds or less

So if you want to be updated more regularly, you can do that here:
YouTube Instagram TikTok

[hr][/hr]

Final Words
Thanks for sticking around or stumbling upon this game by accident. More updates are coming.
The game is alive. I am alive.

More soon. Maybe even on time this time.
